name: House (classic)
description: Four-on-the-floor house grid: kick every beat, snare on 2 and 4, straight 16th hats, open hat on the off-beat.

source.note: Drum grid taken verbatim from Strudel's drum_patterns.mjs, which credits lvm/tidal-drum-patterns under GPL-3.0. This repo is AGPL-3.0-or-later; GPLv3 to AGPLv3 is permitted under AGPLv3 section 13.
